description: The Mayhem app's window (mayhem.rs, its own EXE): follows the ARAM Mayhem champion select of the League client on this PC (read-only, its password stays in Rust), reads the champion's public stats from arammeta.com and mayhemstats.lol (only the champion's number goes out), the signed-in player's own rank and the leaderboard from mayhemstats.lol (read-only, only the player's own identifiers go out), the augment and champion tier lists with champion details, items and patch changes from arammeta.com (one public list, nothing sent) and the item list from Data Dragon, and writes its errors to the local error log. Opens a champion's guide page on aramonly.com in the browser (aram_open_guide, a fixed address). Updates itself on click (update.rs, as blank.): asks GitHub for the latest release of maltekruse23-oss/blank with its English notes, and only on the install click downloads that release's mayhem.exe from GitHub, checks size and GitHub's SHA-256, replaces the running file and restarts; update_news says once after an update that it should show what is new. The page cannot name another file or address. "Find my Mayhem rank" (mayhem_find_rank, aram/ladder.rs): on click uploads the signed-in player's own ARAM Mayhem games from the client's history (the client's answer per game, only games that name the player and the site does not count yet) to mayhemstats.lol's archive with this installation's random upload key from the Windows Credential Manager, then reads the rank; after each ARAM Mayhem game the same happens by itself only while mayhemstats.lol lists the player. The page names nothing of it. Nothing else; no window, filesystem, shell or HTTP permissions.
